Container/Container.php#Container#__get.reason: Dynamic property sugar over offsetGet; intercepting property access would put a Luau __index function on the framework's hottest object, firing for every unset optional field. The offset* methods it sugars are ported. Revisit if a metatable spelling with acceptable cost is found.

Container/Container.php#Container#__set.reason: Dynamic property sugar over offsetSet; same boundary and same revisit condition as __get.

Container/Container.php#Container#bindBa.reason: Derives the bound abstracts from the closure's return types via ReflectsClosures; rbxtsc erases every type and a compiled function value carries no signature (the trait's own waiver). forgetScopedInstances' closure branch is the same omission downstream. Revisit if bound-types-from-closures get a decorator spelling.

Container/Util.php#Util#getParameterClas.reason: Reads a class off a ReflectionParameter type hint; signatures are erased, and @Inject (conventions.json 'inject') is the port's spelling of the hint -- ParameterDependency.abstract carries what this read. The registry is the permanent replacement.

Container/BoundMethod.php#BoundMethod#ge.reason: Builds the ReflectionFunction/ReflectionMethod the dependency walk reads; the port reads the @Inject registry instead, and getCallDependencies is its counterpart. Reflection does not exist on the platform.

Container/BoundMethod.php#BoundMethod#ad.reason: Folded into getMethodDependencies' loop, which mirrors its pendingDependencies shape inline; the ReflectionParameter-driven branches (name-keyed overrides, defaults, isOptional) have no platform spelling. Revisit the split if the loop body grows.

paths.reason: The class-attribute registry standing in for `ReflectionClass::getAttributes()` -- the runtime half of the reflection-registry convention: a decorator records its instance here and the container reads it back.

The @Inject parameter registry standing in for PHP's constructor type hints and ReflectionParameter reads (conventions.json 'inject'/'reflection-registry'): ParameterDependency is the port's ReflectionParameter.
The variadic half of the @Inject registry -- `ReflectionParameter::isVariadic()` spelled as an annotation, since a compiled signature says nothing.
The Contract<T> token -- an erased interface's stand-in as a container key (conventions.json 'contract-token'), carrying the FQCN for messages and a phantom type parameter for make()'s return type.
The component's type vocabulary (Abstract, Concrete, ParameterOverrides, the callback shapes) -- PHP spells these as docblock unions on the members; TS needs them declared once.

The language compensations for PHP dynamic calls and capability checks -- call ((...)), callMethod (->{}(...)), methodExists, isCallable -- which PHP gets from the language itself. Lives at the bottom of the import graph so Support (HigherOrderWhenProxy) and Pipeline can both reach it without cycles.

Port-only helper with no upstream twin: isPipeArray/wrapPipes/isPipeWithParameters tell one parameterized pipe `[Class, 'args']` from a list of pipes -- a distinction PHP spells inside a single string ('Class:args') and never has to make, because a class is not a string on this platform. isPipeArray is Pipeline.through()/pipe()'s is_array; wrapPipes serves Routing/Route and Routing/Controller.

traits.Illuminate\\Support\\Traits\\Macroable: Needs __call on the class itself; deferred platform-wide, facades carry the static half.
traits.Illuminate\\Support\\Traits\\ReflectsClo: closureReturnTypes() reads a Closure's return types off ReflectionFunction; rbxtsc erases every type, and a compiled Luau function value carries no signature at all -- the same boundary that defers bindBasedOnClosureReturnTypes and forgetScopedInstances' closure branch. Revisit if bound-types-from-closures ever get a decorator spelling.

heritage.ArrayAccess: PHP's array-subscript operator interface; an index and a property access are one expression in TS, and hooking it would put a Luau __index function on the framework's hottest object. The four offset* methods it demands are ported as plain public API. Revisit if a metatable sugar with acceptable cost is ever wanted.
heritage.NotFoundExceptionInterface: PSR-11 marker interface; the port vendors no Psr layer -- get()/has() live on the container contract itself, and EntryNotFoundException extends the port's Exception. Revisit if a Psr contracts directory ever lands.
heritage.Countable: SPL interface hooking PHP's count() builtin; Luau's # cannot be hooked for a class without metatable work nothing here calls -- callers use the explicit count() method the class ports. Revisit if roblox-ts grows operator interfaces.
heritage.IteratorAggregate: SPL interface hooking foreach; roblox-ts iterates generators and arrays, not custom iterables, so callers call getIterator() explicitly (or toArray()). Revisit if roblox-ts gains Symbol.iterator support.
